Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 6h 35m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  5 AE orders reported stuck. 4 confirmed COMPLETED. 1 order (AE260812-57849665) remains stuck at SHIPPING_REQUESTED with partial cancellation failure. Parallel investigation launched across Kibana, codebase, and DB. Next step is deeper trace on the remaining order. (35m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation auto-triggered at 2026-09-08T04:16:32Z. RCA file not yet generated — investigation is in progress. Next step is completing the parallel investigation fan-out and writing the RCA. (45m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. 11 remediated after SMC team completed device and product mappings. 3 remain in ERROR — unmapped A36 device model, invalid identity document, and invalid product ID. All blocked on SMC/Subs team. Will reuse PC-52678. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  Good, I can see all the RCA files. Note that `SAHME-3407. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — Request to allocate 0.01 to the accessory SKU
  Investigation locked at 2026-09-08T09:46:00+09:00. RCA file not yet generated — investigation is in progress. Next step is completing the investigation and writing the RCA.

SAME-3958 — 
  SA Sales Report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Analysis confirmed fields exist in Hybris type system but were never added to SaSalesReport.groovy. Updated script prepared under PC-53689 with two new @ColumnMethod handlers. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — Order Refund Failed - Manual Refund
  I'll start the investigation following the workflow. Let me begin with Phase 0 - reading past learnings and checking for existing cache files.

Open tickets:

SAME-3962 [In Progress] — Order Refund Failed - Manual Refund
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAHME-3421 [In Progress] — Request to allocate 0.01 to the accessory SKU
  Todo: Continue investigation.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

AEME-6540 [In Progress] — [PROD] | Manual Chargeback || 07-Sep
  Todo: Continue investigation.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,

Aryan
